readmeExcerpt:
# WOTS+ Solidity Implementation

A Solidity implementation of the Winternitz One-Time Signature Plus (WOTS+) scheme.

## Development

This project uses both Hardhat and Foundry for development and testing.

### Prerequisites

1. Install Foundry:
```bash
curl -L https://foundry.paradigm.xyz | bash
foundryup
```

2. Install Node.js dependencies:
```bash
npm install
```

### Testing

Run the Foundry tests:
```bash
forge test -vv
```

The `-vv` flag increases verbosity to show more test details. Use `-vvv` for even more detailed output including stack traces.

### Building

```bash
forge build
```

aiSummary.oneLiner: A Solidity implementation of the quantum-resistant Winternitz One-Time Signature Plus (WOTS+) scheme.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: This repository provides a concrete Solidity implementation of the Winternitz One-Time Signature Plus (WOTS+) scheme, a hash-based cryptographic algorithm. It introduces post-quantum signature capabilities directly to EVM-compatible blockchains. The project utilizes industry-standard development frameworks, specifically both Hardhat and Foundry, to ensure rigorous testing and security. By implementing WOTS+, it allows smart contracts to verify signatures that are theoretically resistant to attacks from future quantum computers, enhancing long-term blockchain security.
keyFeatures: WOTS+ Implementation: Accurately implements the complex Winternitz One-Time Signature Plus algorithm in native Solidity.
Quantum Resistance: Introduces foundational post-quantum cryptographic primitives to Ethereum and EVM-compatible networks.
Dual-framework Testing: Leverages both Hardhat and Foundry to ensure the highest standards of code correctness and vulnerability prevention.
Hash-based Security: Relies entirely on secure hash functions rather than vulnerable elliptic curve cryptography.
EVM Compatibility: Designed to run efficiently within the constraints of the Ethereum Virtual Machine.
Developer Ready: Includes a standardized setup process with clear prerequisites for easy integration by other developers.
